name: Panaderia Mi Tierra
whatItIs: Latin American bakery and convenience grocery owned by Guatemalan-born Ana Cuadros and co-owner Pablo Gonzales; breads, cakes, pastries, groceries, piñatas.
evidence: The Globe, July 15, 2026, gives the address and says the store is open 6 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. every day.

name: Tortilleria El Maná
whatItIs: Guatemalan-owned tortilla shop that also sells Guatemalan dishes; food trailer serves Turkey Valley Farms in Marshall and Premium Iowa Pork in Luverne.
evidence: The Globe, July 22, 2026, lists hours of 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. weekdays and 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. weekends; owners say they hope to expand.

name: La Eterna Primavera
neighborhoodOrCity: Worthington (inside Corky's Corner, Oxford and McMillan streets)
whatItIs: Small restaurant opened by San Marcos-born former JBS worker Humberto Chavez Perez; tortas, tacos, flautas, made-to-order and grab-and-go.
evidence: The Globe reported it would open Friday, May 29, 2026, with hours of 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.; no later page confirming it is operating was opened.

name: Tienda Chapin 2
whatItIs: Guatemalan grocery owned by Vinicio Perez with Central American produce, cheeses, baked goods (pan galleta, milhojas), medicines and snacks.
evidence: Park Rapids Enterprise, Oct. 1, 2025, reports it opened Aug. 1, 2025, and describes current stock.

name: Tienda Chapin
whatItIs: Guatemalan grocery, sister store to Tienda Chapin 2; posts deliveries of mangoes, Creole chickens, queso fresco, jocote and epazote.
evidence: Park Rapids Enterprise, Oct. 1, 2025, describes the Willmar store as its operating sister store and cites its current Facebook delivery posts. Address not given.

name: Tienda Maya Quiche
whatItIs: Store opened July 1, 2022, by K'iche' Maya siblings Francesca, Martín and Tomás Quila; Latin American groceries and meat counter, handmade K'iche' clothing, shoes and pottery.
evidence: Only the 2022 opening article was found; no 2025 or 2026 page showing operation was found.

name: Tienda Guatemala
whatItIs: Store described in 2010 as carrying specifically Guatemalan goods plus household items, spices, music and clothing.
evidence: Only a 2010 Globe shopping guide mentions it; no current page found.

name: Tienda Telvis II
whatItIs: Mexican-American family store (not Guatemalan-owned) serving the Latino community, including Guatemalan families: religious goods, quinceañera and wedding items, food, drinks, money transfers; earlier sold airline tickets with Guatemala and Mexico the top destinations.
evidence: The Globe, June 15, 2026, says it is open 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. seven days a week.

name: K & W Innovations
whatItIs: Vendor selling Guatemalan/Mexican raspados (shaved ice) and fresas con crema at the 2026 International Festival.
evidence: Listed as a vendor for the July 2026 festival; no standing business location or ownership found.

name: Our Lady of Guadalupe Free Clinic (OLGFC)
whatItIs: Free clinic for uninsured residents founded in 2011 by the Rev. Jim Callahan and Dr. David Plevak; Sanford Health Cooperative nurses, pharmacist and interpreter on Wednesdays, periodic Saturday specialty clinics. Serves many immigrant groups, not only Guatemalans.
evidence: Own site is live with current mission content; Star Tribune report of Dec. 2024 describes it operating, and The Globe (Dec. 13, 2022) gives the address.

name: St. Mary's Catholic Church
whatItIs: Catholic parish with Spanish Masses, about 10 Latino choirs including Guatemalan members, host of the Esquipulas feast and past Guatemalan mobile consulates.
evidence: Own site lists current Mass times (Spanish Saturday 7 p.m., Sunday 11 a.m.); The Globe, Oct. 20, 2026, announces its Nov. 8 Fall Festival.

name: CLUES (Comunidades Latinas Unidas En Servicio)
neighborhoodOrCity: St. Paul (East Side headquarters), Minneapolis, Willmar, Austin
whatItIs: Statewide Latino-serving nonprofit; not specific to Guatemalans but has offices in Willmar and Austin, two cities with Guatemalan populations.
evidence: Own site lists weekday hours, 2026 election notices and a 2025 impact report (30,000+ served).

name: Consulate General of Guatemala in Omaha
neighborhoodOrCity: Omaha, Nebraska (1010 N 96th St., Suite 200); jurisdiction includes Minnesota
whatItIs: Guatemalan government consulate serving Iowa, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota and Minnesota.
evidence: Directory page updated Oct. 26, 2026, lists 2026 Saturday consular service dates; AGN (May 18, 2023) reported Minnesota in its jurisdiction.
